verdict.rationale: Claude Design says it turns static mockups into shareable interactive prototypes, and its output is real HTML/CSS/JS, which can in principle carry rich behavior. Community users report building animated SVGs, though one notes that SVG export strips animations unless worked around. Nothing documents state-to-state transitions, conditional logic or variables, or scroll effects as prototyping features. Missing for 10: documented animation between prototype states, conditions/variables support, scroll effects, and hands-on corroboration of advanced prototype interactions beyond SVG animation.
